description: Pull finished calls back from the AI-Call-Bot into the leads' timelines: status, outcome, duration, transcript and the bot's AI summary (stored in ai_summaries per call, returned as `summary` by list_lead_messages and get_lead; a summary the bot writes later is added by the next run — see summary_pending). Idempotent — a call already stored is updated, never duplicated. Only calls the bot marked with external_system 'callpilotai' are considered, so calls made elsewhere in the bot are left alone. Optional: lead_id (just that lead), limit (default 25, max 200). Run this after start_bot_call; the bot cannot push results yet.
name: sync_bot_calls
